brief:
Nearly one in three reported violations against children worldwide occurred in Palestine in 2025, according to Al Jazeera English. The figure places the occupied territory at the center of documented harm to minors during the year.

The data reflects cases of attacks on children across all countries globally, with Palestine accounting for a disproportionate share of reported incidents in 2025.

title: One-third of global child attacks recorded in Palestine
